insight: Founded in Melbourne; its Point72-led $65M Series B (Oct 2025) valued it at $465M as it supported 2M+ consults a week.
name: Heidi
tagline: An AI medical scribe and care partner with a free tier for individual clinicians.
description: Heidi is an AI clinical assistant that transcribes consults and generates notes, letters, and forms for clinicians, with clinical decision support via its Evidence feature and a wearable Heidi Remote microphone for hands-free capture. It supports over two million consults a week in 110 languages, used by GPs, specialists, nurses, and allied health globally. A free tier covers core scribing; paid plans unlock advanced features and team controls.
edge: A clinician-led scribe with a real free tier and 110-language coverage — reaching solo GPs and small clinics, not just enterprise health systems.
cons: Younger US enterprise footprint than rivals
